description: End-to-end quality control and assurance workflow for B2B unified communications services (voice, messaging, collaboration), covering test plan definition, execution, monitoring, incident handling, remediation, and regression verification.

service_bundle_id.description: Identifier for a unified communications bundle (e.g., voice + messaging + meetings)

test_plan_id.description: Identifier for a QA test plan

test_suite_id.description: Identifier for a logical group of related test cases

test_run_id.description: Identifier for an execution of a test plan or suite

incident_id.description: Identifier for a detected quality or service incident

remediation_id.description: Identifier for a remediation or change set applied to resolve quality issues

environment_id.description: Identifier for an environment (lab, staging, production slice) where tests run

test_case.description: Definition of a single QA test case

id.description: Local identifier within the test plan or suite

preconditions.description: Conditions that must be true before running the test

steps.description: Ordered steps to execute the test

metrics.description: Metrics to capture for this test case

mos_threshold.description: Minimum acceptable MOS score for voice quality, if applicable

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: define_quality_threshold_profile
functions.description: Create or update a reusable quality threshold profile for a tenant, environment, or service bundle.

inherit_from_profile_id.description: Optional base profile to inherit defaults from

override_strategy.description: How to apply overrides relative to an inherited profile

requested_by.description: User or system that requested the change

functions.returns: Saved threshold profile with resolved effective thresholds and version metadata.

functions.name: create_test_plan
functions.description: Create a new QA test plan for a tenant's unified communications deployment, including suites and test cases.

associated_threshold_profile_id.description: Threshold profile to apply for pass/fail decisions

suites.description: List of test suites included in the plan

cron_expression.description: If type=cron, the cron expression in UTC

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, used for display only

labels.description: Free-form labels for filtering and reporting

functions.returns: Created test plan with test_plan_id, normalized suites, and scheduling metadata.

functions.name: list_test_plans
functions.description: List and search QA test plans for a given tenant, with filtering by environment, status, and labels.

label_selector.description: Label selectors for filtering (exact match). All specified labels must match.

search.description: Free-text search in name and description

functions.returns: Paginated list of test plans with basic metadata, including test_plan_id and current status.

functions.name: start_test_run
functions.description: Start execution of a test plan or suite in a specific environment, with resource and scope options.

test_suite_id.description: Optional: run only a specific suite from the plan

execution_scope.description: Scope control for which test cases to run

max_concurrent_cases.description: Maximum number of concurrent test cases

probe_pool.description: Named pool of test probes/endpoints to use

network_profiles.description: Optional network impairment profiles to apply

run_metadata.description: Additional metadata for the test run

functions.returns: Created test run with test_run_id, initial status, and resolved execution plan.

functions.name: get_test_run_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status, progress, and key metrics for a test run.

include.description: Specify additional details to include in the response.

case_filter.description: Optional filter for returned per-case status.

functions.returns: Current test run status, progress, and optional detailed information by suite and test case.

functions.name: collect_test_run_results
functions.description: Collect and aggregate detailed results and raw metrics from a completed or in-progress test run.

aggregation_level.description: Primary level of aggregation for metrics.

metric_filters.description: Filters for metrics and dimensions of interest.

include_raw_samples.description: Whether to include raw sample-level metrics.

functions.returns: Aggregated metrics, per-dimension statistics, and optionally raw samples for the specified test run.

functions.name: evaluate_run_against_thresholds
functions.description: Evaluate a test run's results against a threshold profile and generate pass/fail verdicts and deviations.

threshold_profile_id.description: Threshold profile to use. If omitted, uses the profile associated with the test plan or tenant default.

evaluation_scope.description: Scope of evaluation (e.g., only certain services or categories).

min_severity.description: Only return deviations at or above this severity.

auto_open_incidents.description: Automatically create incidents for critical deviations.

functions.returns: Evaluation summary with pass/fail verdicts, list of threshold deviations, and any auto-created incident_ids.

functions.name: detect_quality_incidents
functions.description: Detect and correlate quality incidents for a tenant based on recent test runs and live monitoring signals.

lookback_minutes.description: If from/to omitted, relative lookback window.

signals.description: Signals to consider for incident detection.

functions.returns: List of newly detected or updated incidents with incident_id, scope, severity, and supporting evidence.

functions.name: get_incident_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details, history, and current status of a quality incident.
functions.returns: Incident details including status, severity, scope, impact assessment, timeline, and related objects.

functions.name: propose_and_apply_remediation
functions.description: Generate remediation options for a quality incident and optionally apply a selected remediation to the affected environment.

selection.description: Selection of remediation to apply when mode=apply_selected.

remediation_template_id.description: Identifier of a remediation template or pre-generated option.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate remediation without making changes.

functions.returns: List of proposed remediations with impact estimates, and if applied, remediation_id and change execution status.

functions.name: rollback_remediation
functions.description: Rollback a previously applied remediation in case of regression or new issues.

partial_scope.description: Scope for partial rollback if strategy=partial.

functions.returns: Rollback execution result, including status, any issues encountered, and new configuration checkpoint reference.

functions.name: schedule_regression_test_after_change
functions.description: Schedule and configure a targeted regression test run after a remediation or configuration change.

base_test_plan_id.description: Base test plan for regression. If omitted, the plan associated with the incident or remediation will be used.

regression_scope.description: Specify what subset of tests to run as regression.

scheduling.description: When and how to run the regression.

delay_minutes.description: Delay relative to now if start_time_utc is not set.

run_window_minutes.description: Maximum allowed duration for the regression run.

functions.returns: Planned regression test run with test_run_id, scope details, and evaluation settings.

functions.name: retry_failed_test_cases
functions.description: Retry failed or flaky test cases from a previous test run with optional overrides and flakiness detection.

custom_selection.description: Explicit test cases to retry when strategy=custom_selection.

execution_overrides.description: Overrides for execution environment or parameters.

flakiness_detection.description: Options for detecting and marking flaky tests.

mark_flaky_threshold_pct.description: Percentage of failures across retries above which a test is marked flaky.

functions.returns: New test_run_id for the retry execution, with mapping to original cases and flakiness annotations.

functions.name: search_tenants
functions.description: Faceted search across tenant records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for quality_assurance_flow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of tenant records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A tenant record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

functions.name: bulk_archive_tenants

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

functions.name: export_tenants

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.name: unsubscribe_tenant_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created tenant event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.name: get_tenant_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a tenant including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.name: query_tenant_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for quality_assurance_flow with field-level filters.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization
